items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces and a surjective etale U -> X with R = U x_X U, any O_X-module F fits into an exact sequence 0 -> f_*F -> a_*(F|_U) -> b_*(F|_R) whose second arrow is the difference t^* - s^* (source lines 2054-2067). The proof evaluates the sequence at an object V of Y_etale: the sections of f_*F over V are the sections of F over V x_Y X, the etale morphism V x_Y U -> V x_Y X is a covering, and the fibre product (V x_Y U) x_X (V x_Y U) is V x_Y R, so the displayed sequence is exactly the sheaf condition for F on the big etale site; functoriality in V then yields the sheaf statement.
